description: This file defines a module for computed properties in Dojo, including functions for observing property changes, computing derived properties, and managing dependencies between dojo/Stateful objects.

methods.name: watch
methods.description: Sets up observation on a dojo/Stateful property, calling a callback on change.

methods.name: getProps
methods.description: Retrieves current values of specified dojo/Stateful properties.

methods.name: removeHandles
methods.description: Removes a list of handles by calling their remove method.

methods.name: computed
methods.description: Creates a computed property on a dojo/Stateful object that depends on other properties, updating automatically when dependencies change.
